ai-evaluation-framework.excerptFallback: Automated validation loops that replace vibe-based prompt testing with deterministic, multi-judge quality gates.
ai-evaluation-framework.humaneProblem: Creative AI output is a liability in production. A small prompt shift can introduce discriminatory language, break a layout, or violate labor law — and no human team can review thousands of generated ad variants by hand.
ai-evaluation-framework.humaneSolution: An automated testing layer enforces quality across the whole generation lifecycle. The moment the AI produces copy, it is intercepted and graded against structured criteria; if it fails a legal or quality check, the system generates remedy instructions and auto-corrects before any user sees a failure.
ai-evaluation-framework.technicalProblem: Model drift across providers makes output unpredictable, and gating production requires quantitative feedback rather than loose text analysis, with zero-tolerance gates for compliance.
ai-evaluation-framework.technicalSolution: A multi-judge LLM-as-judge system: smaller thematic judges evaluate specific dimensions in parallel to save tokens and avoid context-window drift, feeding a blind-ranked prompt-optimization loop.
ai-evaluation-framework.technicalSpecs: Wired into Langfuse via TypeScript/Hono, running 73 binary assertions across 6 judges (Legal Compliance, Best Practices, Content Relevance, Content Quality, Campaign QA, Extraction Accuracy) at a 10% production sampling rate. Golden datasets version-controlled as JSONL.

langfuse-refactor.humaneProblem: AI pipelines become unmanageable when prompts are hardcoded in source files. Versioning is impossible, and changing one instruction means a full deployment, leaving developers blind to failures.
langfuse-refactor.humaneSolution: Langfuse became the operational control layer: every prompt pulled out of the code into a versioned, secure cloud environment, with instant promotion and rollback across environments and Slack error alerts.
langfuse-refactor.technicalProblem: Prompt iteration was coupled to the deploy cycle, with no tracing linking a generation failure to a specific prompt version.
langfuse-refactor.technicalSolution: Prompts organized as system/user/chat triplets composed dynamically at runtime, matched to production spans via Langfuse trace metadata.
langfuse-refactor.technicalSpecs: Shipped across 12 endpoints. Runtime prompt promotion via env labels (dev/stg/prd) with no code deploy; OpenTelemetry trace linkage for version-level observability.

surgical-chat-provenance.excerptFallback: Content provenance that protects manual human edits from being silently overwritten by later AI-generation rounds.
surgical-chat-provenance.humaneProblem: When a user manually edited an AI-generated ad or landing page, asking the chatbot for a follow-up change silently regenerated the whole page and wiped their work — destroying trust.
surgical-chat-provenance.humaneSolution: A content fingerprint system marks which fields are pure AI and which a human touched, so the AI is instructed to surgically edit only untouched fields and preserve human choices verbatim.
surgical-chat-provenance.technicalProblem: The assistant had no awareness of the boundaries of manual edits across multiple entities (Feeds, Stories, WelcomeScreens, Forms), causing destructive overwrites on save.
surgical-chat-provenance.technicalSolution: The AI-Pristine provenance architecture writes cryptographic field signatures on generation, enabling asymmetric drift detection on user save.
surgical-chat-provenance.technicalSpecs: AiBaselineService (PHP/Laravel) stores SHA256-truncated content signatures in polymorphic metadata. The Hono chat gateway runs a silent blast-zone check before dispatching background jobs, stripping edited fields from the AI mutation scope. (ENG-4216)

ai-image-pipeline.humaneProblem: The marketing team depended on expensive stock photography with slow turnaround and limited flexibility.
ai-image-pipeline.humaneSolution: An on-demand AI image-generation pipeline integrating Midjourney and Magnific upscaling, producing royalty-free, brand-fit assets and eliminating annual stock costs.
ai-image-pipeline.technicalProblem: Stitching multiple image models and an upscaler into a reliable, cost-aware production flow.
ai-image-pipeline.technicalSolution: A Python/Laravel pipeline orchestrating generation, upscaling, and validation, later hardened with direct provider routing to cut timeouts.
ai-image-pipeline.technicalSpecs: Eliminated €10,000+ in annual Shutterstock cost; integrated Midjourney, Magnific, and Imagen with on-demand generation.

tartarus-ai-operating-substrate.excerptFallback: A local-first, sovereign AI workspace — persistent context, journal memory, media, and agent tooling over MCP.
tartarus-ai-operating-substrate.humaneProblem: Testing cutting-edge AI orchestration, experimental schemas, or custom MCP servers inside a live enterprise environment is a major security and downtime risk.
tartarus-ai-operating-substrate.humaneSolution: Tartarus is a local-first personal AI workspace and private sandbox where new technologies are hardened before production — credential security, encryption-at-rest, media sync, and MCP-based resource exposure.
tartarus-ai-operating-substrate.technicalProblem: Loading large-scale personal context (writings, files, project history) with strict type safety and minimal latency in a single local server.
tartarus-ai-operating-substrate.technicalSolution: A Next.js + Hono + SQLite (WAL) stack with Drizzle schemas and an esbuild-optimized stdio-to-HTTP MCP bridge, plus local-to-cloud media sync.
tartarus-ai-operating-substrate.technicalSpecs: Orchestrates context across many SQLite tables, loads a lean baseline and additively merges skills on demand; esbuild-optimized MCP bridge wrapping stdio protocols.

hades-bi-platform.excerptFallback: An ETL pipeline that classified 23K+ campaigns into ISCO/NACE/NUTS taxonomies to power forecasting and BI.
hades-bi-platform.humaneProblem: The company sat on disconnected oceans of unstructured data — CRM extracts, Excel, Metabase exports, Meta API metrics — with no common taxonomy, making aggregate analysis impossible.
hades-bi-platform.humaneSolution: A modular ETL pipeline that ingests, cleans, and standardizes disparate sources into optimized databases, then compiles aggregate BI and forecasting on top.
hades-bi-platform.technicalProblem: Classifying tens of thousands of unstructured job postings into international occupational, industrial, and geographic standards was too slow and costly with synchronous calls.
hades-bi-platform.technicalSolution: A layered Python/SQL pipeline using the OpenAI Batch API for bulk hierarchical classification, with weighted-scoring forecasting over the cleaned dataset.
hades-bi-platform.technicalSpecs: Classified 23,199 campaigns into ISCO/NACE/NUTS, reducing API cost ~50% and lookup queries from 12 to 3 per job; feeds PostHog HogQL dashboards and a cost-forecasting engine.

campaign-labeling-pipeline.humaneProblem: Manual labeling of campaign data for BI would take thousands of human hours with high error rates.
campaign-labeling-pipeline.humaneSolution: A Python CLI that mass-labels and validates campaigns with well-prompted structured LLM outputs, cutting processing from hours to minutes.
campaign-labeling-pipeline.technicalProblem: Reliable, cost-effective structured extraction at scale over noisy real-world data.
campaign-labeling-pipeline.technicalSolution: Async CLI pipeline normalizing data and using Gemini Flash for ~99% reliable structured outputs into SQLite.
campaign-labeling-pipeline.technicalSpecs: 26K campaigns + 7K companies labeled to ISCO/NACE at a fraction of crowd-labeling cost; built the database that powers forecasting.
